title: CauchyNet: Compact and Data-Efficient Learning using Holomorphic Activation Functions

split.decision: Materialize original clipped-normal synthetic split, data seed 10: 200 train / 50 val outside turning gaps; 100 held-out inside gaps. Preserve archived float32 arrays and row order. No generator or source history exposed.

baseline.paper_ref: Camera-ready Table 1 row 7; fixed ten-seed suite

allowed_changes: Compact function-estimator architecture, surrogate loss, optimizer and training strategy within the same capacity budget.

When retaining the supplied CauchyNet pipeline, changing only lr=0.05, epochs=3000, batch_size=32, hidden_size=64, r_re=2.5, r_im=0.4, imag_pen=0.0 or StepLR(2000, 0.5) does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Minimize mean gap-filling MAE across ten independently fitted seeds under the fixed 128-real-parameter capacity budget.
Fixed scalar regression observations, gap/validation design, hidden targets and ten model seeds.
At most 128 real learned parameters per model; complex scalars count twice.
Per-seed float32 MAE followed by float64 ten-seed mean; no ensemble replacement.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Using a larger model, hidden fitted constants or an ensemble to replace the controlled-capacity experiment.
Using the paper target formula/hidden split as an oracle or changing data, target function or MAE aggregation.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
